protected_intent.public_signature: pub fn format_duration(duration: std::time::Duration) -> impl std::fmt::Display
protected_intent.observable: exact UTF-8 string produced by Display::to_string() for a literal std::time::Duration

fields.secs: unsigned integer in the std::time::Duration domain

classification.Preserved: Every required positive case returns its exact expected string, all structural requirements pass, and repetition plus reordering preserve the vector.
classification.Violated: A constructible duration returns a different string, a required public or purity property fails, or a valid negative mutation survives.
classification.Unknown: The input or observation is deliberately opaque, malformed or outside the std::time::Duration/output model; Unknown gives zero acceptance credit.

structural_requirements.rule: Pieces appear only in day, hour, minute, sub-minute order.
A number and its unit have exactly one ASCII space; adjacent pieces have exactly one ASCII space.
When day or hour is nonzero, seconds and fractions are omitted.
At five minutes or above, the seconds remainder is integral and its fractional part is dropped.
Below five minutes, the selected scalar is rounded to two decimal places and trailing zeroes are not forced.
The thresholds 1 s, 1 ms and 1 µs are inclusive for the larger unit.
Zero follows the seconds branch and is represented exactly as 0 s.
The implementation accepts the frozen Duration argument and performs no clock, sleep, environment, filesystem, network, scheduler, watch or global-state access.
The function and module are public through the L2 crate index without changing L1, L3 or L4.

negative_cases.mutation_class: day divisor changed from 24 hours
hour divisor changed from 60 minutes
minute divisor changed from 60 seconds
piece order permuted
seconds retained after a nonzero day or hour
minutes omitted when nonzero
five-minute threshold shifted from 300.000 seconds to 300.010 seconds
fraction retained for durations at or above five minutes
second boundary changed from inclusive to exclusive
millisecond boundary changed from inclusive to exclusive
microsecond boundary changed from inclusive to exclusive
rounding replaced by truncation
precision changed from two decimal places
trailing decimal zeroes forced
ASCII spacing changed or removed
unit label changed including replacement of micro sign U+00B5
zero special case removed or assigned a larger unit
subsecond scale exponent shifted
input replaced or perturbed by wall clock, elapsed time, scheduler or watch state
public function, argument or return Display contract removed or made private
23-hour rollover changed to one day early
299.999-second rounded scalar normalized into the next minute instead of preserving piece mechanics

opaque_cases.observation: Display formatting aborted before a complete string is returned
output bytes are not valid UTF-8

determinism.required_result: The complete ordered case-id to output mapping is identical in every repetition and independent of execution order.

excluded_equivalent_mutations: Changing only duration >= 5 minutes to duration > 5 minutes: at exactly 300 seconds both branches render 5 min 0 s, so no observable in this contract distinguishes them.

execution_policy.test_command: one exact unit test per invocation
execution_policy.streams: redirect stdout and stderr to files

scope_boundary.future_watch_status_binding: not covered and must be specified, measured and authorized in a separate step
scope_boundary.claim: This contract covers only the pure S11 duration formatter and its L2 public adapter.
